k: A long-lived mutant soldier with bone claws
Wolverine, a clawed mutant with an adamantium skeleton
st: Logan fights wars beside Victor, quits Team X, then becomes Weapon X and loses his memory to an adamantium bullet.
A cage fighter in Canada, Logan saves Rogue from Sabretooth and joins the X-Men to rescue her from Magneto.
Logan faces Stryker and Lady Deathstrike at Alkali Lake and loses Jean when she stays behind to save the team.
When Jean returns as the Phoenix and tears Alcatraz apart, Logan reaches her and kills her to save everyone.
Haunted by Jean, Logan goes to Japan, loses his healing for a time, and protects Mariko Yashida.
Kitty sends his mind to 1973 to unite young Charles and Erik; he wakes in a new 2023 where the X-Men live.
In 1983, Stryker holds him as Weapon X until Jean frees him and he tears his way out into the snow.
In 2029, an aging Logan protects Laura, kills X-24, and dies in her arms near the border.

k: Professor X, telepathic founder of a school for mutants
st: Xavier telepathically guides the mutant children freed from Three Mile Island to safety.
Xavier takes in Logan and Rogue, survives Mystique's sabotage of Cerebro, and visits Magneto in his plastic prison.
Stryker captures Xavier and forces him to use a copy of Cerebro to target every mutant, until the X-Men free him.
The Phoenix disintegrates Xavier; after the credits, his voice comes from a comatose man in Moira's care.
Two years after Japan, Xavier and Magneto approach Logan at an airport to warn him of a new threat.
In the dark 2023, Xavier helps send Logan's mind back to 1973, and history changes for the better.
In 2029, a frail Xavier with deadly seizures is hidden by Logan, and X-24 kills him at the Munson farm.

k: Professor X, head of a school for mutants
st: Charles helps the CIA recruit young mutants and stops Shaw, but a deflected bullet leaves him paralyzed.
Charles opens his school with Hank, Alex, and Sean as Erik leaves with Raven.
In 1973, his school closed, Charles joins Logan to stop Raven and talks her out of killing Trask.
Apocalypse kidnaps Charles to take his body, and Jean's power saves him, though he loses his hair.
After Jean's powers spiral and Raven dies, Charles steps down as dean and makes peace with Erik in Paris.
Charles and the X-Men are glimpsed in a room at the mansion during Deadpool's visit.

k: A teenager whose eyes fire powerful blasts
st: Teenage Scott is captured by Stryker for his eye blasts and freed by Logan.
Cyclops leads the X-Men against Magneto at the Statue of Liberty.
Stryker brainwashes Cyclops into fighting Jean, and he loses her at Alkali Lake.
Grieving, Scott goes to Alkali Lake, where the returned Jean kills him.
In the new 2023 that Logan wakes to, Scott is alive at the school.

k: Alex Summers's younger brother, whose eyes fire blasts
st: Scott's powers emerge, Alex brings him to Xavier's school, and he loses Alex in the blast that destroys the mansion.
He helps defeat Apocalypse and becomes one of the new X-Men.
Scott stands by Jean as her powers spiral and fights to save her from the D'Bari.
Cyclops is glimpsed with the X-Men at the mansion during Deadpool's visit.
Jean helps lead the X-Men, treats Logan, and helps restore Xavier after Cerebro is sabotaged.
Her powers grow; she holds back the flood at Alkali Lake and is lost beneath the water.
Jean returns from Alkali Lake ruled by the Phoenix, begs Logan to save her, and he kills her.
In the new 2023 that Logan wakes to, Jean is alive at the school.

k: A gifted young telepath at Xavier's school
st: Jean befriends Scott, frees Weapon X, and unleashes her full power to destroy Apocalypse.
A cosmic force strikes Jean in space; it overwhelms her, and she kills Raven by accident.
She saves the mutants from the D'Bari, carries Vuk into space, and becomes a fiery phoenix.

k: Ororo Munroe, an X-Man who controls the weather
st: Storm fights the Brotherhood and strikes Toad with lightning at the Statue of Liberty.
She finds Nightcrawler with Jean and helps free the captive children at Alkali Lake.
After Xavier's death, Storm leads the X-Men at Alcatraz and becomes the school's headmistress.
In the dark 2023, Storm falls to the Sentinels while defending the temple, before Logan changes history.

k: Ororo Munroe, a young mutant who controls the weather
st: Ororo turns on Apocalypse and joins the new X-Men.
Storm fights Jean in New York, then defends the mutants from the D'Bari on the train.
Storm is glimpsed with the X-Men at the mansion during Deadpool's visit.

k: Marie, a runaway who absorbs anyone she touches
st: Rogue runs away after her powers put a boy in a coma, and Magneto uses her to power his machine.
Rogue escapes Stryker's raid on the mansion with Logan and grows closer to Bobby.
Rogue takes the mutant cure so she can touch the people she loves.
In the new 2023 that Logan wakes to, Rogue is back at the school with Bobby.

k: A student at Xavier's school who controls ice
st: Bobby befriends Rogue when she arrives at Xavier's school.
He takes Logan, Rogue, and John to his parents' home, where he reveals he is a mutant.
Iceman defeats Pyro in a duel during the Battle of Alcatraz.
In the dark 2023, Iceman falls to the Sentinels, but in the new 2023 Logan wakes to, he is alive.

k: A student who can phase through solid matter
st: Kitty phases through the walls to escape Stryker's raid on the mansion.
Kitty saves Jimmy from Juggernaut during the Battle of Alcatraz.
In 2023, Kitty sends Logan's mind back to 1973 and holds it there until history changes.

k: Piotr Rasputin, a student who can turn to steel
st: Colossus helps the students escape Stryker's raid on the mansion.
Colossus fights beside the X-Men in the Battle of Alcatraz.
In the dark 2023, Colossus falls to the Sentinels, but in the new 2023 Logan wakes to, he is alive.

k: Kurt Wagner, a devout teleporting mutant
st: Under Stryker's control, Kurt attacks the President, then helps the X-Men rescue Xavier and the children.

k: A teleporting teen from an East Berlin cage fight
st: Raven rescues Kurt from a cage fight, and he teleports the X-Men out of the crashing jet.
Kurt teleports the X-Men to New York to save Jean and fights the D'Bari on the train.
Nightcrawler is glimpsed with the X-Men at the mansion during Deadpool's visit.

k: Beast, the Secretary of Mutant Affairs
st: Dr. Hank McCoy talks about mutants on a TV news show.
Beast quits the government over the cure, fights at Alcatraz, and becomes an ambassador to the United Nations.
In the new 2023 that Logan wakes to, Beast is at the school.

k: A young CIA scientist with ape-like feet
st: Hank builds Cerebro for the CIA, takes his own serum, and turns blue and furry.
In 1973, Hank cares for a broken Charles and joins Logan to stop Raven.
Hank trains young mutants, is captured by Stryker, and flies the X-Men to Cairo.
Blaming Charles for Raven's death, Hank joins Erik to kill Jean, then makes peace and heads the school.
Beast is glimpsed with the X-Men at the mansion during Deadpool's visit.

k: A winged mutant whose father makes the cure
st: Warren refuses his father's cure, flies to Xavier's school, and saves his father at Alcatraz.

k: Leech, a boy whose power cancels mutations
st: Jimmy's genes are the source of the mutant cure, and Kitty saves him from Juggernaut at Alcatraz.

k: A doctor and friend of Charles Xavier
st: Moira cares for a comatose man, who greets her with Xavier's voice.

k: A CIA agent investigating the Hellfire Club
st: Moira brings Charles to the CIA, stands with the young mutants in Cuba, and has her memory wiped.
In Cairo, Moira helps the X-Men stop Apocalypse, and Charles gives her memory back.

k: Charles Xavier's adopted sister, a shape-shifter
st: Raven trains with Charles's young mutants for the CIA, then embraces her blue form and leaves with Erik.
In 1973, Raven spares Trask, saves the President from Erik, and walks away.
She rescues Kurt, rallies the young mutants against Apocalypse, and stays to train the X-Men.
Raven tries to reach an out-of-control Jean Grey and dies by accident.
Erik teams up with Charles to hunt Shaw and helps recruit young mutants for the CIA.
Freed from the Pentagon to help stop Raven, Erik turns on Charles and Logan.
After serving Apocalypse, Erik turns on him and helps rebuild Xavier's school.
Erik fights beside Jean and the X-Men against the D'Bari, then joins Charles for chess in Paris.

k: Erik Lehnsherr, an aging master of magnetism
st: Two years after Japan, Magneto and Xavier approach Logan at an airport to warn him of a new threat.
In the dark 2023, Magneto fights the Sentinels beside Xavier and helps send Logan's mind back to 1973.

k: A young mutant who fires energy blasts
st: Alex trains with Charles and fights Shaw's men in Cuba.
In Vietnam in 1973, Alex is among the mutant soldiers Raven frees from Stryker.
Alex brings his brother Scott to Xavier and dies in the blast that destroys the mansion.

k: Banshee, a mutant with a sonic scream
st: Sean learns to fly with his scream and fights Shaw's men in Cuba with Charles's team.

k: Darwin, a mutant who adapts to survive
st: Armando joins Charles's recruits, and Shaw kills him by forcing Havok's blast into him.

k: A teen speedster from the suburbs
st: Peter helps Charles, Hank, and Logan break Erik out of the Pentagon in 1973.
Knowing Erik is his father, Peter saves the students from the mansion blast and joins the X-Men.
Jean injures Peter when the X-Men confront her at her childhood home.
Quicksilver is glimpsed with the X-Men at the mansion during Deadpool's visit.

k: A mutant who absorbs and fires energy
st: In the dark 2023, Kitty sends Bishop's mind back to warn the team of Sentinel attacks, until the final attack kills him.
In the dark 2023, Blink's portals help the X-Men outrun the Sentinels, until the final attack kills her.

k: Roberto da Costa, a mutant who burns with solar fire
st: In the dark 2023, Sunspot fights the Sentinels beside the X-Men and dies in the final attack.

k: James Proudstar, a mutant with keen senses
st: In the dark 2023, Warpath senses the Sentinels coming and dies in the final attack.

k: A student at Xavier's school in 1983
st: Jubilee takes Scott, Jean, and Kurt to the mall in 1983.
Jean finds her father alive, learns he let her believe he died, and Vuk later kills him.

k: Remy LeBeau, a card-charging thief in New Orleans
st: Remy, who escaped Stryker's island, fights Logan, then flies him there and helps free the captives.

k: Remy LeBeau, a card-charging mutant in the Void
st: In the Void, Gambit fights Cassandra Nova's forces beside Laura, Elektra, and Blade.

k: A teacher in Canada and Logan's partner
st: Kayla lives with Logan in Canada until she appears to be murdered by Victor.
She is revealed to be working for Stryker to save her sister, then helps the captives escape and dies.

k: Kayla's sister, whose skin turns to diamond
st: Stryker holds Emma in his island lab until Logan and Kayla free her.

k: A teleporting member of Team X
st: Ex-Team X member John Wraith helps Logan track down Stryker, and Victor Creed kills him.

k: A former Team X member, now a boxer
st: Out of shape and boxing, Fred Dukes tells Logan that Gambit knows the way to Stryker's island.

k: Bolt, a Team X member who controls electricity
st: Now working at a carnival, ex-Team X member Chris Bradley is killed by Victor Creed.

k: Travis and Heather, an elderly farm couple
st: The Hudsons shelter Logan after he escapes Weapon X, and Agent Zero kills them.

k: Granddaughter and heir of Ichiro Yashida
st: Yakuza try to kidnap Mariko at her grandfather's funeral, and Logan protects her.
She defeats her grandfather's plan, takes over his company, and says goodbye to Logan.

k: A red-haired fighter who foresees deaths
st: Yukio brings Logan to Japan to say goodbye to the dying Ichiro Yashida.
She fights to save Logan and Mariko, then leaves Japan with Logan as his bodyguard.

k: A girl made by Transigen from Logan's DNA
st: Laura escapes Transigen with Gabriela and goes on the run with Logan and Charles.
She helps kill X-24, buries Logan, and crosses toward Canada with the other children.
In the Void, Laura fights Cassandra Nova and is rescued afterward to Wade's universe.

k: An albino mutant tracker who shelters Logan and Charles
st: Caliban helps Logan hide and care for Charles, until the Reavers capture him.
Forced to track mutants for Pierce, he sets off grenades to kill himself and the Reavers around him.
Gabriela smuggles Laura out of Transigen and asks Logan to drive them north, then the Reavers kill her.
The Munsons take in Logan, Charles, and Laura for a night, and X-24 kills them.
The escaped children, led by Rictor, fight the Reavers beside Logan and Laura and cross toward Canada.

k: A Cheyenne teen, sole survivor of her reservation
st: Dani wakes in Dr. Reyes's hidden hospital after a disaster destroys her reservation.
Her power to make fears real unleashes the Demon Bear, which she calms before leaving with her friends.

k: A Scottish teen who turns into a wolf
st: Rahne befriends and falls for Dani, attacks Dr. Reyes, and escapes with the group.

k: A sorceress with a puppet dragon named Lockheed
st: Illyana takes up her Soulsword and armor to battle the Demon Bear, then escapes with the group.

k: A teen from Kentucky who flies with energy
st: Sam, haunted by a mine collapse, fights the hospital's horrors with his friends and escapes.

k: A wealthy teen who burns with heat
st: Roberto, haunted by his girlfriend's death, fights the hospital's horrors with his friends and escapes.

k: Wade Wilson, a scarred mercenary who can't die
st: Dying of cancer, Wade takes a treatment that cures him but scars him, and hunts Ajax as Deadpool.
With Colossus and Negasonic's help, Deadpool rescues Vanessa and kills Ajax.
After Vanessa is killed, Wade tries to protect young Russell and is locked in the Ice Box with him.
He forms X-Force, teams up with Cable, and takes a bullet for Russell; Cable's last jump saves him.
With Cable's repaired device, Wade goes back in time and saves Vanessa and Peter.
Retired and single, Wade learns from the TVA that his universe is dying and is sent to the Void.
Back home, Wade and a Logan variant destroy the Time Ripper together and save their universe.
Vanessa falls for Wade, and Ajax kidnaps her to draw out Deadpool, who rescues her.
Vanessa is killed by men hunting Wade, until Wade uses Cable's device to save her.
Now split from Wade, Vanessa is at his birthday party and among the friends he fights to save.

k: Wade's best friend and a bartender at Sister Margaret's
st: Weasel runs Sister Margaret's bar and helps Deadpool find Ajax.
Weasel helps Deadpool hold tryouts for X-Force.

k: A cab driver and Deadpool's biggest fan
st: Dopinder drives Deadpool to his fights and takes his advice on love a little too far.
Dopinder wants to be a hero, and he runs over the orphanage headmaster with his cab.
Dopinder is at Wade's birthday party, telling stories to the guests.
Blind Al takes in the scarred Wade as her roommate.
Blind Al is still Wade's roommate as he grieves Vanessa.
Blind Al is among the friends Wade tries to save when his universe faces collapse.
Colossus tries to recruit Deadpool to the X-Men and helps him defeat Ajax's forces.
Colossus makes Wade an X-Men trainee, then helps stop Juggernaut at the orphanage.
Colossus is at Wade's birthday party.

k: A moody teen X-Men trainee with explosive power
st: Negasonic joins Colossus to help Deadpool fight Ajax's forces.
Now an X-Man, she repairs Cable's time travel device for Wade.
Negasonic is at Wade's birthday party with Yukio.
Yukio, Negasonic's girlfriend, cheerfully greets Wade at the X-Mansion.
Yukio is at Wade's birthday party with Negasonic.

k: A mercenary whose power is luck
st: Domino joins X-Force, survives its first mission, and helps Deadpool and Cable save Russell.

k: A regular guy who joins X-Force
st: Peter joins X-Force and dies on its first mission, until Wade goes back in time to save him.
Peter works with Wade at a car lot and comes to help when Deadpool variants attack.

k: Bedlam, Shatterstar, Zeitgeist, and the Vanisher
st: Deadpool recruits a new team to stop Cable, and its members die one by one on their first jump.

k: A biker friend of Wade's at Sister Margaret's
st: Buck is among the regulars at Sister Margaret's bar.
Buck is at Wade's birthday party.

k: A cybernetic soldier from the future
st: Cable teams up with Deadpool to save Russell and spends his last time jump to save Wade.

k: A young mutant who throws fire
st: Moved by Deadpool's sacrifice, Russell spares the orphanage's headmaster.

k: Scott Summers, the X-Men's field leader
st: Cyclops leads the X-Men in the field against the Sentinels, Magneto, and the Brotherhood.
He marries Jean and learns the space pirate Corsair is his father.
Cyclops is in the Danger Room when Spider-Man comes to Xavier for help with his mutation.
With Jean and Logan, he brings Magneto word that Xavier is dying.
Scott and Jean's son Nathan is born, but Sinister infects him and Bishop takes him to the future.
After Bastion's war, Asteroid M's explosion throws Scott and Jean into 3960 A.D.
In the future, they help Nathan escape Apocalypse's followers, then return to the 1990s.
Back home, Scott fights Danger on Genosha, and Rogue frees him from Apocalypse's control.

k: A telepath and telekinetic, Xavier's first student
st: Jean fights beside the X-Men and grows close to Scott, despite Wolverine's feelings for her.
The Phoenix Force bonds with her after a shuttle crash and turns dark, until Jean is freed of it.
She marries Scott and, with him and Logan, brings Magneto word that Xavier is dying.
Jean escapes Sinister to find her clone, Madelyne, has lived her life and borne Scott's son.
Jean taps the Phoenix to stop Bastion, then Asteroid M's explosion throws her into 3960 A.D.
In the future, she helps Nathan escape Apocalypse's followers, then returns to the 1990s.

k: Logan, a clawed mutant with a healing factor
st: Wolverine saves Jubilee from the Sentinels and clashes often with Cyclops over Jean.
He uncovers his past at a ruined Weapon X lab, with Alpha Flight, and beside Captain America in WWII.
Wolverine tracks down Spider-Man after Beast vanishes, and they team up to rescue him.
On Asteroid M, Magneto rips the adamantium from Wolverine's skeleton before the asteroid explodes.
Found by Forge in 3960 A.D., he returns home and regains his adamantium in a Brood-infested Weapon X lab.
Storm defeats Callisto to free Cyclops from the Morlocks and survives her claustrophobia on Genosha.
She resists the Shadow King and refuses to marry the alien tyrant Arkon.
Storm questions Spider-Man when he comes to the X-Mansion seeking a cure.
Spider-Man brings Storm to the Beyonder's planet, where she helps defeat the Red Skull and Doom.
The X-Cutioner's blast strips Storm's powers, and she leaves the team.
With Forge's help, she defeats the Adversary and regains her powers.
Lost in time after Asteroid M explodes, she is found by Forge in 3960 A.D. and returns home.
Xavier names Storm headmistress of his school.

k: A Southern mutant who absorbs powers by touch
st: Raised by Mystique, Rogue joins the X-Men and slowly opens her heart to Gambit.
Rogue flirts with Spider-Man when he visits the X-Mansion.
Rogue reveals her past romance with Magneto and loses Gambit in the Genosha massacre.
Grieving, Rogue hunts Gyrich and Trask, then sides with Magneto before Asteroid M explodes.
Stranded in ancient Egypt, she watches En Sabah Nur become Apocalypse and returns home.
Kidnapped by a possessed Gambit, she gains a Celestial's power, frees him, and traps Apocalypse.

k: Remy LeBeau, a Cajun thief who charges objects
st: Gambit helps free Genosha's mutant slaves and stops Mystique's plot against Senator Kelly.
He returns to New Orleans to save his brother from the Assassins Guild.
Gambit is in the Danger Room when Spider-Man comes to Xavier for help.
Gambit dies destroying Master Mold to save Genosha.
Apocalypse raises Gambit as a Horseman; Rogue frees him, and he returns to the X-Men.

k: Dr. Hank McCoy, a blue-furred genius
st: Captured in a Sentinel raid, Beast refuses Magneto's offer to break him out of prison.
Back with the X-Men, Beast fights the Friends of Humanity for Carly and helps defeat the Phalanx.
Beast sends Spider-Man to Dr. Herbert Landon for a cure, then Landon's men capture him until he is rescued.
Beast and Forge build a collar to cut Bastion's control of the Sentinels.
Stranded in ancient Egypt, he builds a time device from Apocalypse's Ship and returns home.
Jubilee, a foster teen hunted by Sentinels, is rescued by the X-Men and joins the team.
On her 18th birthday, Jubilee escapes Mojo's video game with Roberto and kisses him.
Jubilee joins Cable's X-Force, is captured by X-Factor, and escapes with other young mutants.
She leaves X-Force and returns to the X-Men.

k: Charles Xavier, founder of the X-Men
st: Xavier leads the X-Men and faces Magneto, his old friend.
Powerless in the Savage Land with Magneto, he is captured by Sinister and freed by the X-Men.
Xavier tells Spider-Man, who fears his growing mutation, that he cannot cure him.
Gyrich gravely wounds Xavier, and Lilandra takes him into space to be healed.
Healed and engaged to Lilandra, Xavier returns to Earth after a vision of the Genosha massacre.
He stops Magneto's blackout, then Asteroid M's explosion throws him into ancient Egypt.
He watches Apocalypse kill Magneto and is rescued by Bishop.
Xavier moves the X-Men to Genosha as X-Corp and faces Apocalypse inside Gambit's mind.
Morph seemingly dies in a Sentinel raid.
Morph returns, brainwashed by Sinister, until Xavier frees him and he rejoins the X-Men.
Morph leads the X-Men to Sinister's lab, where they find baby Nathan.
Lost in time, Morph returns home and joins Wolverine's raid on a Weapon X lab.

k: A mutant from a Sentinel-ruled future
st: Bishop travels back from a Sentinel-ruled future to stop the assassination of Senator Kelly.
He returns to stop Apocalypse's plague and clashes with Cable.
Bishop takes baby Nathan to the future for a cure and later finds where the X-Men are lost in time.
Bishop rescues Xavier from ancient Egypt.

k: Nathan Summers, son of Scott and Madelyne
st: Cable helps Gambit escape Genosha and fights Apocalypse in his own future.
Baby Nathan is infected by Sinister and taken to the future; he returns grown as Cable to warn of Bastion.
Young Nathan merges with Apocalypse's Ship, and later Cable forms X-Force to stop Apocalypse.
Cable shoots Gambit, unleashing Apocalypse, and Rogue hands him a crystal holding Apocalypse.
Freed from Sinister by Jean, Madelyne helps save baby Nathan and gives him to Bishop.
Taking the name Madelyne Pryor, she leaves the team, then recognizes Cable as her grown son.
Magneto helps the X-Men destroy Master Mold and later joins them against the Phalanx.
Named the X-Men's leader in Xavier's will, Magneto stands trial and is pardoned.
Stranded in ancient Egypt, he saves a city from a black hole, and Apocalypse kills him.

k: Kurt Wagner, a devout teleporting mutant
st: Gambit, Rogue, and Wolverine protect Nightcrawler, a monk in a mountain abbey, from a fearful mob.
He learns Mystique is his mother and Rogue his foster sister.
Kurt joins the X-Men after Genosha and is stranded with them in ancient Egypt.
Back home, he defends his half-brother Graydon Creed and beats Exodus in a sword duel.
Kurt offers his own life to the Celestial Eson so Rogue and Gambit can be together.

k: Piotr Rasputin, a Russian mutant who turns to steel
st: Framed by Juggernaut, Colossus is helped by the X-Men and later fights Omega Red with them.
Living with the Acolytes in the Savage Land, he judges Graydon Creed, then returns to the school.
Forge leads X-Factor and, in a dark future, the resistance against the Sentinels.
Forge tries to restore Storm's powers and helps her defeat the Adversary.
Forge travels to 3960 A.D. to find the lost X-Men and bring them home.

k: Roberto da Costa, a young mutant who channels solar power
st: Roberto is saved from the Friends of Humanity and joins the X-Men.
He escapes Mojo's game with Jubilee, then joins Magneto on Asteroid M.
Roberto joins Cable's X-Force with Jubilee, then returns to the X-Men.
Psylocke, a lone warrior, helps the X-Men against Apocalypse.
Psylocke joins Cable's X-Force to hunt Apocalypse's Horsemen.

k: Warren Worthington III, a winged mutant
st: Apocalypse turns Warren into a Horseman, and Rogue drains part of his dark side.
Obsessed with revenge, Archangel hunts Apocalypse with Rogue's help.
Archangel joins X-Force and executes War on Cable's orders.
Lorna, Iceman's former girlfriend, has joined X-Factor and fallen for Havok.
As Polaris, she helps Jubilee escape X-Factor, is dismissed, and returns to the X-Men to beat Danger.
Havok of X-Factor clashes with the X-Men at a government site.
Havok's X-Factor hunts X-Force for the government and captures Jubilee.

k: Bobby Drake, one of the original X-Men
st: Iceman breaks into a government site to find Lorna and learns she has joined X-Factor.

k: A Shi'ar princess who loves Xavier
st: Lilandra seeks the X-Men's help in space and later takes the wounded Xavier to be healed.
Now empress, she plans to marry Xavier, but he returns to Earth after Genosha.

k: A geneticist and Xavier's old love
st: Moira runs her lab on Muir Island and asks the X-Men to help her son, Proteus.
Moira sits on Genosha's council and dies in the Sentinel attack.
Banshee, a mutant with a sonic scream, aids the X-Men with Moira.
Banshee sits on Genosha's council and dies in the Sentinel attack.

k: Leader of the Askani in a far future
st: Mother Askani pulls the X-Men through time to train Nathan and stop Apocalypse.
In WWII, Captain America teams with Wolverine to rescue a scientist from the Red Skull.
Captain America gives Rogue a lead as she hunts Gyrich.
With Black Widow, he hands Wolverine a file on Weapon X.
Black Widow joins Captain America in handing Wolverine a file on Weapon X.

k: A space pirate on the run from the Shi'ar
st: Corsair, hunted by the Shi'ar, is revealed to be Cyclops's father.
Ka-Zar rescues the powerless Xavier and Magneto and helps them against Sinister's followers.

k: A rebel star who fled Mojo's network
st: Longshot flees Mojo to Earth, regains his memories, and fights Mojo with the X-Men.

k: Alison Blaire, a singer with light powers
st: The Hellfire Club targets the singer Dazzler, and the X-Men step in.
Dazzler is on Genosha and dies in the Sentinel attack.
Alpha Flight captures Wolverine for the Canadian government, then turns and helps him escape.

k: Mister Fantastic, who can stretch his body
st: Reed takes his crew to Victor von Doom's space station, where a cosmic storm makes him elastic.
As Mister Fantastic, he leads the Fantastic Four against Doom and wins Sue back.
Reed tracks the Silver Surfer for the military as his wedding to Sue keeps getting interrupted.
Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer
The team saves Earth from Galactus, and Reed and Sue finally marry in Japan.
Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer

k: A scientist at Victor von Doom's company
The Invisible Woman, who turns invisible
st: Sue joins Reed's mission to Doom's space station, where a cosmic storm lets her turn invisible.
Sue fights Doom beside the Fantastic Four and rekindles her romance with Reed.
Sue befriends the Silver Surfer and dies shielding him from Doom, until the Surfer brings her back.
Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer
After Galactus is stopped, Sue marries Reed in Japan.
Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer

k: The Human Torch, who bursts into flame
st: Johnny gains fiery powers on Doom's station, names the team the Fantastic Four, and loves the fame.
Touched by the Surfer, Johnny swaps powers on contact, then takes on all four's powers to defeat Doom.
Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer
Captured in the Void with Wade and Logan, Johnny is killed by Cassandra Nova.

k: The Thing, a man of living rock
st: Ben is turned into a rocky giant on Doom's station, and his fiancée leaves him.
He finds love with Alicia Masters and chooses to stay the Thing to save Reed from Doom.
Ben stands with the team against the Silver Surfer and Doom.
Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer
Alicia befriends Ben after his change and falls for him.
Alicia attends Reed and Sue's wedding with Ben and supports the team.
Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer
Debbie drops her engagement ring and leaves after seeing what Ben has become.

k: A military captain working with General Hager
tm: Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer
st: Captain Raye works with the military to catch the Silver Surfer and reconnects with Johnny.
Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer

tm: Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer
st: Moved by Sue, the Surfer turns on Galactus and saves Earth, then drifts in space with his board.
Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer

k: Eric Brooks, a half-vampire vampire hunter
st: Blade hunts vampires with Whistler, saves Dr. Karen Jenson, and kills Deacon Frost.
Blade rescues Whistler and joins forces with the Bloodpack to hunt the Reapers.
Framed by vampires and hunted by the FBI, Blade teams with the Nightstalkers to kill Drake.
In Detroit, Blade turns Krista Starr into his agent inside the House of Chthon.
In the Void, Blade fights Cassandra Nova's forces beside Laura, Elektra, and Gambit.
Whistler arms Blade, and Deacon Frost's vampires bite him and leave him for dead.
Blade finds Whistler held as a vampire and cures him.
Whistler dies when the FBI raids his base.

k: A hematologist bitten by a vampire
st: Bitten by Quinn, Karen joins Blade, cures herself, and helps him defeat Frost.
Scud arms Blade while Whistler is missing, but he is a spy for Damaskinos, and Blade kills him.

k: A vampire warrior, daughter of Eli Damaskinos
st: Nyssa hunts the Reapers with Blade and comes to trust him, until Nomak's bite dooms her and she dies in the sun.

k: A vampire strike team trained to kill Blade
st: The Bloodpack joins Blade to hunt the Reapers, and the Reapers and Reinhardt's betrayal kill them one by one.

k: Whistler's daughter and a vampire hunter
st: Abigail and the Nightstalkers rescue Blade from the FBI and fight Drake beside him.

k: A former vampire who hunts them
st: Hannibal helps rescue Blade, is captured and tortured by the vampires, and fights on with Abigail.

k: A blind scientist with the Nightstalkers
st: Sommerfield builds the Daystar virus, and the vampires kill her in their raid.
Drake's vampires kidnap Zoe, and Blade and the Nightstalkers rescue her.
Hedges arms the Nightstalkers and dies when the vampires raid their hideout.
Dex dies when the vampires raid the Nightstalkers' hideout.

k: A soldier back from Iraq looking into her brother's death
st: Marcus Van Sciver turns Krista into a vampire, and Blade's serum lets her fight her thirst.
Krista goes undercover in the House of Chthon for Blade to bring down Marcus.
Shen makes Blade's serum and gear and helps him hunt the vampires who killed his sister.

k: A blind lawyer in Hell's Kitchen
Daredevil, a vigilante with heightened senses
st: Blinded as a boy, Matt hunts criminals at night as Daredevil and falls for Elektra.
After Bullseye kills Elektra, Matt beats Bullseye and the Kingpin and leaves Fisk for the police.
Elektra falls for Matt and fights Daredevil, believing he killed her father, before Bullseye kills her.
Revived by Stick, Elektra becomes an assassin and protects Mark and Abby Miller from the Hand.
In the Void, Elektra fights Cassandra Nova's forces beside Laura, Blade, and Gambit.
Foggy works beside Matt at their small law firm and worries about his double life.

k: A reporter for the New York Post
st: Ben investigates Daredevil, learns he is Matt Murdock, and chooses to keep it secret.
Jack refuses to throw a fight for the mob, and they kill him.
Nikolas tries to break with the Kingpin, and Bullseye kills him.

k: A blind master of the Chaste
st: Stick revives Elektra, trains her, and sends the Chaste to save her from the Hand.
Hunted by the Hand as the Treasure, Abby fights beside Elektra, dies, and is brought back to life.
Mark befriends Elektra, learns she was hired to kill them, and flees the Hand with her.
McCabe gives Elektra her jobs and dies holding off the Hand so she can escape.

k: An FBI agent about to retire
st: After a sting kills Bobby Saint, his father's men massacre Frank's family and leave him for dead.
As the Punisher, Frank turns Howard Saint against those closest to him and kills the Saint family.

k: Frank Castle's wife, son, and parents
st: Howard Saint's men kill Frank's family at a reunion in Puerto Rico.
Joan befriends Frank, nurses him after a fight, and survives the attack on their building.

k: A pierced loner in Frank's building
st: Saint's men torture Dave, but he refuses to give up Frank.

k: A cheerful cook in Frank's building
st: Bumpo befriends Frank and, with Joan and Dave, patches him up after the Russian's attack.

k: King of the Inhumans, whose voice can destroy
st: Exiled to Hawaii by Maximus's coup, Black Bolt is jailed, freed by Sammy, and held in Declan's lab.
He reunites his family, outwits Maximus, seals him in Attilan's bunker, and leads his people to Earth.

k: Queen of the Inhumans, who moves her living hair
st: Maximus shaves Medusa's head and she lands powerless on Oahu, where Louise helps her find Black Bolt.
Medusa helps her family retake Attilan and stands with Black Bolt as the Inhumans settle on Earth.

k: An Inhuman who sees the flaw in everything
st: Lockjaw sends Karnak to Oahu, where he is captured by cannabis growers and falls for Jen.
Karnak revives Gorgon through a second Terrigenesis and escapes Maximus's cell with him.

k: An Inhuman with hooves that make shockwaves
st: Gorgon goes to Earth to find Triton and rescues Karnak and Jen.
He dies saving the others from Mordis, then Terrigenesis brings him back with a wild mind.
The revived Gorgon kills Declan and begins to remember his family.

k: Medusa's sister, who controls the elements
st: Crystal sends her family to safety with Lockjaw, defies Maximus, and escapes to Earth.
She bonds with Dave on Oahu and helps her family plan the evacuation of Attilan.
Lockjaw teleports the Royal Family to Earth, is hurt in a crash, and is healed by Dave's friend Audrey.
Ambushed on Oahu, Triton leaps into the ocean and is feared dead.
Triton returns alive and captures Maximus for Black Bolt.
Louise helps Medusa find Black Bolt and keeps the Inhumans' Terrigen crystals safe on Earth.
Dave finds Crystal and the wounded Lockjaw, gets them help, and grows close to Crystal.
Jen falls for Karnak, is wounded escaping the growers, and is saved by Gorgon.

k: An Inhuman inmate with heat powers
st: Sent by Declan to befriend Black Bolt, Sammy breaks him out of prison and is later rescued by Gorgon and Karnak.
Disillusioned with Maximus, Auran gives Karnak her DNA to revive Gorgon and joins the evacuation.

k: An Inhuman of Attilan's Genetic Council
st: Tibor plots with the rebels to overthrow Maximus, who kills him.

k: A living teleport in Attilan's walls
st: Eldrac carries the people of Attilan to Earth and dies with the city.

k: A gamer and son of Geoffrey and Catherine Wilder
st: Alex reunites his old friends and finds their parents' group, the Pride, sacrificing a girl.
On the run, Alex makes deals with Darius, falls for Livvie, and tricks his parents into arrest.
Alex is revealed to be possessed by Jonah's son and is left trapped in the Dark Dimension.
His friends rescue him; years later his evil future self returns and is sent back to prison.

k: A goth teen whose sister Amy died
st: Nico takes her mother's Staff of One and learns magic as the Runaways expose the Pride.
On the run, she falls for Karolina and makes AWOL's men vanish with a new power.
Nico banishes Jonah's family, trains with Morgan le Fay to save Alex, then helps stop Morgan.
Three years later, she has mastered her magic abroad and joins the mission to save Gert.

k: Daughter of Leslie Dean of the Church of Gibborim
st: Without her church bracelet, Karolina glows with light; she learns Jonah is her father.
Kidnapped by Jonah, then on the run, she falls for Nico and meets Xavin, her betrothed.
Karolina escapes Jonah's prison and fights Morgan le Fay with her friends.

k: An activist teen linked to a dinosaur
st: Gert learns her parents built a dinosaur, Old Lace, who bonds with her mind.
On the run, she falls for Chase, until her mother makes her sick to bring her home.
Gert dies fighting Morgan le Fay, until the future Runaways go back and save her.
Chase quits lacrosse after stopping an assault on Karolina and builds his Fistigons.
He goes back to his parents to stop the Pride from within and is captured by Jonah.
Chase escapes, and years later his future self dies saving Gert.

k: Gert's adopted sister, with super strength
st: Molly discovers her strength and finds the tape where her real parents warn her about the Pride.
On the run, the Runaways throw her a quinceañera in their hideout.
Morgan's phone controls Molly and her coven takes her, until the Pride rescues her.
Old Lace bonds with Gert and joins the Runaways, until the Yorkes recapture her.
Old Lace stays by Gert's side and roars in grief when Gert dies.
Xavin finds Karolina and tells her they are betrothed.
Xavin helps the Runaways against Jonah's family and leaves Earth with Leslie's baby, Elle.
Livvie falls for Alex, then leaves to protect her sister Tamar.

k: Leader of the Church of Gibborim
st: Leslie turns on Jonah, is held by her own church, and the kids rescue her.
Leslie gives birth to Jonah's daughter, Elle, and rebuilds the church.
Trapped in Jonah's prison, Janet stays behind so Chase and Karolina can escape.
Janet knocks out Morgan's phone service in Los Angeles.
Dale lets Gert go and teaches her to guide Old Lace, as Jonah's family possesses Stacey.
Freed, the Yorkes join the Pride in saving Molly and protecting the kids from Morgan.
Freed from Jonah's family, Tina warns Nico about Morgan le Fay.
Tina uses her magic to banish Morgan back to the Dark Dimension.
Freed from Morgan's spell, Robert gets Nico pages from the Darkhold, and Morgan kills him.
Geoffrey breaks Morgan's hold, rallies the Pride to save Molly, and is wounded.
Freed from Jonah's family, Victor learns Janet is gone and joins the fight against Morgan.

k: A teen grifter who survived the Roxxon rig explosion
st: Years after the rig explosion killed her father, Tandy meets Tyrone and gains daggers of light.
With Tyrone, she absorbs the energy at Roxxon's core and saves New Orleans.
Andre and Lia trap Tandy at the Viking motel, until her hope and powers return.
After they defeat Andre, Tandy leaves New Orleans with Tyrone to be heroes.
Tandy and Ty help the Runaways rescue Alex from the Dark Dimension.

k: A teen whose brother was shot by a cop
st: Years after Billy's death, Tyrone meets Tandy and finds he can teleport through shadow.
He finishes Billy's cloak and scares Connors into confessing, but is framed for murder.
With Tandy, he saves New Orleans at Roxxon's core, then hides in her church.
Ty and Tandy defeat Andre, his name is cleared, and they leave town to be heroes.
Ty and Tandy help the Runaways rescue Alex from the Dark Dimension.
O'Reilly investigates Connors with Tyrone's help, until Connors shoots her and she falls into the sea.
She survives split in two, and she and her other self, Mayhem, become one again.
Father Delgado guides Tyrone while hiding his own struggle with drinking.
He returns to the priesthood and takes over Tandy's old church.
Evita helps Tyrone and learns he and Tandy are the Divine Pairing.
Evita opens the way to the Loa realm so Ty and Tandy can face Andre.
Chantelle guides Tyrone through visions and warns of the Divine Pairing.
Andre kills Chantelle by filling her with sadness.
Adina grieves Billy and fears losing Tyrone, then flees the gangs with him.
Once she has proof of Tyrone's innocence, Adina kills Connors.
Otis takes Tyrone to the Mardi Gras chief who holds Billy's unfinished cloak.
Melissa struggles with addiction and grief as Tandy learns how her father abused her.
Melissa relapses, is caught in Andre's trance, and later sees Tandy off.
Mina helps Tandy expose Roxxon, and Tandy and Tyrone wake her father from his coma.
Mina helps study O'Reilly's split and is caught in Andre's trance.
Liam helps Tandy rob a wedding and is arrested, then steals her money.
